meta_description: Flavio's Kitchens specialises in complete kitchen renovations across Southampton. Custom designs, quality installation, and guaranteed workmanship. Call today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Complete kitchen renovations from design through installation. We transform tired kitchens into beautiful, functional spaces you'll love.
services_heading: Complete Kitchen Renovation Services in Southampton
services_subhead: From bespoke cabinetry to full refits, we handle every aspect of your kitchen transformation.

services.title: Full Kitchen Refurbishment
services.desc: Complete strip-out and rebuild. We manage everything—new layouts, electrics, plumbing, and gas—to building regs and to your exact brief.

services.title: Bespoke Fitted Kitchens
services.desc: Custom-built cabinetry and worktops tailored to your space and taste. Quality hardwood and premium finishes that last.

services.title: Kitchen Design & Planning
services.desc: Professional design service using CAD. We optimise layout, storage, and workflow so your new kitchen works as beautifully as it looks.

services.title: Worktops & Splashbacks
services.desc: Supply and fit granite, quartz, laminate, or wood. We measure, template, and install to perfect fit—no gaps, no fuss.

services.title: Appliance Installation
services.desc: Professional fitting of ovens, hobs, dishwashers, and range cookers. We connect gas and electric safely, test everything, and remove your old appliances.

services.title: Kitchen Extensions & Structural Work
services.desc: Planning and building control liaison, structural beams, new windows, and doors. We coordinate all trades for seamless extension projects.

about_pullquote: Every kitchen tells a story. Ours are built to last and loved every single day.
about_para_1: Flavio's Kitchens was born from frustration—too many rushed installs, poor design, and materials that didn't stand the test of time. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Southampton by doing the opposite: taking time to listen, designing with care, and using quality materials and proven techniques. We've completed over 500 kitchen projects, from compact flats to sprawling family homes.
about_para_2: Our customers return—and refer us—because we treat every job as if it were our own home. You'll work directly with the installation team, not a distant office. We communicate clearly, meet deadlines, and aren't afraid to suggest a better solution if we spot one. A Flavio's kitchen isn't a trend; it's an investment.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Flavio's Kitchens

reviews.text: We were dreading the disruption, but Flavio's team were absolute professionals. They finished bang on schedule, the kitchen looks incredible, and they even helped us decide on the layout when we were unsure. Couldn't fault them.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Quoted by three companies. Flavio's wasn't the cheapest, but the design was miles better and they explained exactly what we'd get. Six weeks later we've got a kitchen we genuinely love. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David M.

reviews.text: Had some old cabinetry that was falling apart. Flavio came round, designed something beautiful that worked with our awkward space, and the whole thing was done in eight days. Minimal fuss, brilliant finish.
reviews.author: Nina P.
